verdict.rationale: Unity documents public scripting APIs for finer programmatic control (unity-docs-11), editor extension APIs (unity-docs-10), and command-line, batchmode and headless operation for automation (unity-docs-6, unity-docs-7, unity-docs-8). A first-party Unity CLI adds structured JSON/TSV output, documented exit codes, and `unity <command>`/`unity eval` commands that drive the Editor directly for agents (unity-probe-rt-4, unity-docs-25). Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of agents driving the Editor through these APIs, the standalone CLI is still experimental, and there is no machine-readable OpenAPI-style spec (the main manual has no llms.txt or .md mirrors).
